acq_time.Description: Recording start from the EDF header. The deposit's dates were already shifted to 2001-01-<deposit day>; the day of the month is set to 01 here (privacy rule: year and month kept, day 01). Time of day unchanged.

deposit_day.Description: Day number of the recording in the deposit (file name dayNN; equals the original shifted day of month). Same as the run label.

edf_subtype.Description: EDF header reserved field: EDF+C (continuous), EDF+D (discontinuous, see sourcedata/edf_discontinuities.tsv) or EDF (plain EDF).

header_date_scrubbed.Description: yes = the EDF header was edited (startdate day -> 01 in the startdate field and the 'Startdate' recording subfield); the data records are byte-identical to the deposit file (sha256 in sourcedata/edf_provenance.tsv).

Levels.no: file byte-identical to the deposit file
